captured: 2026-10-03, MenuAPIUITests testMenuLook / testMenuMotion / testMenuMotion2 (Menus.swift scenes x5menu, PROBE_MENU)
format: jsonl: k=start, touch (phase 0 began / 1 moved / 3 ended, window pt), evt (e=action title=...), windows, frame (cls, id stable per view, x/y = window center, w/h, a opacity, sx/sy, cr) for _UIContextMenuView, _UIContextMenuListView (one per card), _UIContextMenuSubmenuTitleView, UICollectionView; rows only when changed; dl/L rows dropped (the raw files keep them: tool/ios_reference/recordings/device-menumotion2)

files.layout.json: the measured layout, colors, springs (see spec/menu-api.md)
files.mm-sub-tap.jsonl: tap button, tap More (201,238): submenu open
files.mm-sub-back.jsonl: ... then tap the submenu header (201,232.5): back
files.mm-sub-select.jsonl: ... then tap Sub one: action + close
files.mm-sub-slide.jsonl: press the button 0.6 s, slide onto More, hold 1.4 s, lift
files.mm-sub-slide2.jsonl: press 0.6 s, slide onto More, hold 1.5 s, slide to Sub two, lift (fires Sub two)
files.mm-rich1-select.jsonl: keepsMenuPresented taps: Date, Size, Show hidden
files.mm-tall-scroll.jsonl: 30 rows: drag up 300 pt in 0.5 s + hold, flick down
files.mm-deferred.jsonl: uncached deferred element answered after 2 s
files.mm-palette.jsonl: tap the Green palette cell (keepsMenuPresented), then Plain row
files.mm-swiftui2.jsonl: SwiftUI Menu: Count button (menuActionDismissBehavior .disabled) x2, Show hidden toggle
files.card-edge-profile.json: dark native side-edge profile and fitted unlifted sampling displacement
files.card-material-handoff.json: native parent-row visibility and SDF property matching at the 12 ms closing glass hand-off
files.card-container.json: window-bounds fits for the independent 0.35/0.85 closing carrier, per-run presentation delays, submenu opening and hand-back start alignment
files.card-tone.json: native dark face levels, sequential-material transmission fit and phone verification
